newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia repo rate cut effective November 22.
newsitem.headline: Russia repo rate cut effective November 22.

text.p: A cut in the Russian central bank's repo rates announced on Friday will take effect from November 22 and not immediately, a senior central banker said.
Rate changes have to be announced to dealers five working days before they take effect, first deputy chairman Sergei Aleksashenko told Reuters.

Earlier the central bank said it was cutting the rate on its two-day repo facility to 20 percent for deals concluded on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday and to 25 percent for deals on Thursday and Friday from 30 and 40 percent respectively.
The repo facility is currently limited to 650 billion roubles.
The repo facility is restricted to eligible primary dealers in the government securities market. At present 24 of the 42 primary dealers are eligible.
